subject.title: fix(ui): split-view toolbar segments misalign with the panes they label

question: How should the split toolbar represent vertically stacked panes whose content panes share the same horizontal bounds?
rationale: The per-column flex fix aligns horizontal columns, but the existing one-row per-pane controls cannot make multiple vertically stacked panes all have full-width, non-overlapping toolbar segments.

options.title: Require a stacked-pane header model
options.body: Update the PR before merge so the active or selected stacked pane gets a column-width toolbar representation, with proof that its tint and pane ring share edges.

options.title: Accept stacked subsegments
options.body: Merge only if maintainers intentionally accept that stacked panes use subsegments and the PR text/tests stop claiming exact edge alignment for that case.

options.title: Pause this follow-up
options.body: Hold the PR until the split-toolbar UX for vertical pane stacks is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Require a stacked-pane header model
recommendation.body: Update the PR before merge so the active or selected stacked pane gets a column-width toolbar representation, with proof that its tint and pane ring share edges.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged split-toolbar foundation and the current follow-up on the same Control UI surface.
